title: Re-Break Surcharge Schedule, Deficiency Balance Account Payment Plans
content:
**Schedule.** The installment of a new payment plan on an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts carries a re-break surcharge measured from the account's latest broken arrangement, that is, its arrangement offer with the status broken whose broken date is the latest (a broken plan or a broken settlement alike). When that broken date is fewer than 6 whole months before today, the installment carries a surcharge of 10.0 percent; when that broken date is at least 6 but fewer than 12 whole months before today, 5.0 percent; otherwise no re-break surcharge. Whole months are counted as the difference in calendar months between the two dates, less one when the later date's day of the month is below the earlier date's. No two arrangements of an account break on the same day, since an account has only one arrangement in force at a time.

## Schedule table

| Whole months from the latest broken date to today | Surcharge |
|---|---|
| 0 to 5 | 10.0 percent |
| 6 to 11 | 5.0 percent |
| 12 or more, or no broken arrangement | None |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical; today is the 20th of a month)

| Latest broken date | Whole months before today | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| The 21st, six months earlier | 5 | 10.0 percent |
| The 20th, six months earlier | 6 | 5.0 percent |
| The 21st of the same month a year earlier | 11 | 5.0 percent |
| The 20th of the same month a year earlier | 12 | None |

Only the latest broken arrangement is measured; earlier breaks do not add a second surcharge.
